releaseReviewUse.intendedConsumer: Node read-only capture release evidence review
releaseReviewUse.reason: This guide explains field semantics only; it is not a live upstream probe result.

Active Spring profiles, or default profiles when no active profile is set.

Seconds from process start to sampling time; should be non-negative.

Expected actuator health status value.
false in live /api/v1/ops/evidence, true in static sample JSON.

HTTP header required by POST /api/v1/orders.

Same key plus different request is rejected with a stable conflict error code.

Execution mode for the active idempotency store implementation.
